Solusi Prima Packaging

AI Customer Service Automation

A WhatsApp and webchat assistant that answers common packaging questions and helps customers find relevant products.

n8n, Chatwoot, Qontak, API integration

The problem

Customers asked similar questions about packaging and product options across chat channels. Staff had to repeat answers while still making time for requests that needed their judgment.

What I built

I built conversation flows and prompts in n8n and integrated them with WhatsApp and webchat through the support tools. I worked with database records and API integrations as part of the broader support workflows.

Results

The assistant served more than 300 customers and resolved 60% of inquiries without staff assistance, giving the team more room to handle requests that needed a person.

What I learned

I learned that a useful customer reply depends on how well the conversation narrows down the buyer’s needs. Product guidance and a clear next step matter more than a broad answer that leaves the buyer in the same place.
